title: Hatsune Miku — Even What You Don't Want To Hear〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Even What You Don't Want To Hear（4★）

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting. I'm all done now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Busted, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, I can sense when you guys come over to SEKAI so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, is something the matter?
I don't remember hearing anything about you guys having practice here today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, I just came here to talk. You know, about what's been bothering me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall we head over to MEIKO's place...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, here is fine.
Would you mind listening for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, you know...
I really love the way Kohane sings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My heart begins racing whenever she does and feel like something amazing's about to happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's why I want to be by her side...
I want to sing with her forever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to be a partner that she can respect and be proud of!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this is how you truly feel, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It is, and I'm gonna do everything I can to make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If that's the case, good for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I had a feeling that she'd figure out what to do when An was singing with her, but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to hear you make such a clear declaration. I may have to hold you to your word if you really mean it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I absolutely do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (An's finally going back to being her usual self.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, these growing pains are really rough.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Growing pains...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: From becoming someone's partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can't really do much about that, can you? Especially since your partnership's still in its infancy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, this is so hard...
Being way too protective at first was a huge mistake too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Again, I really doubt there was much you could've done about that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She finally found the right partner, but didn't do very well when it came to doing their first event.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm sure she didn't want to lose Kohane so soon either. I can't blame her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you think Akito and Toya had to go through anything like this...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows? Why don't you ask them yourself?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But from what I've gathered, being someone's “partner” is different from being someone's friend or teammate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which also means it's important to be honest with each other, like Akito and Toya.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sometimes you just have to have some tough conversations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm not saying that you should emulate everything they do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Akito and Toya, you and Kohane...
You're all different people with different personalities.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You need to be you, Kohane needs to be Kohane, and the Vivids need to be the Vivids...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Us being us...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. That goes for Vivid BAD SQUAD too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I feel like being a “partner” just became that much more complicated.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm sure experience will be the best teacher there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'll just have to keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I understand why you want to beat yourself up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you were able to take a hard look at yourself and what you were feeling, so I'm sure you'll figure out a way to be the best partner you can for Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. When you say it like that, Miku, it sounds like it's actually gonna happen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: An & Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for everything, Miku!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I might have to come back and ask you for help again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's my job so you're welcome to at any time, especially if it's about your partner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you guys will always have to make the final decision, which I know isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So feel free to ask me about everything else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're way too cool!
